hero.title: Terms and Conditions
intro: These Terms explain how you may use Cur Nova and purchase its educational courses, Usage Units and AI-generated materials. They also explain delivery, cancellation, refunds and the responsibilities of each party.

The Service is operated by CUR NOVA LTD, company number 17240836, whose registered office is Dept 6831, 196 High Road, Wood Green, London, N22 8HH, United Kingdom. In these Terms, “Cur Nova”, “we”, “us” and “our” refer to that company.
For questions about an order or these Terms, contact info@cur-nova.com.

keyPoints.title: Key points
items: Cur Nova provides educational materials. It does not execute trades, manage investments or promise trading results.
You can purchase eligible products directly or use prepaid Usage Units where that option is offered.

Ready-made PDFs are available immediately after successful payment or redemption. Trader Custom Courses normally take 48–96 hours after payment and receipt of the required information. AI materials normally take a few minutes.

Any different delivery arrangement must be disclosed and agreed before payment or redemption for the affected order. We will notify you of delays and offer a revised date or cancellation with the refund due.
Digital delivery does not remove your rights concerning defective content. Any loss of a statutory cooling-off right is subject to the legal requirements explained below.
A legitimate payment dispute does not, by itself, result in a penalty or automatic account suspension.
keyPoints.note: These points are a reading aid. The numbered provisions below explain the terms in full, subject always to applicable mandatory law.

content.text: 1.1. These Terms apply to cur-nova.com, its customer dashboard, associated features and downloadable educational content, collectively the “Service”.

1.2. Please read these Terms before opening an account or placing an order. They form part of your agreement with us when you register for the Service or make a purchase. The order information shown before you commit to payment also forms part of the relevant purchase agreement.

1.3. The Refund and Return Policy explains cancellation and refund procedures. The Privacy Policy explains personal data processing, and the Cookie Policy explains cookies and similar technologies. The Risk and Disclaimer page contains further educational risk information. None of these documents limits rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.

1.4. Cur Nova offers education about trading and financial markets. We do not act as your broker, exchange, investment manager, trading agent or custodian of trading assets. We do not place or monitor trades for you or provide personalised investment advice.

1.5. References to strategies, trading methods or market scenarios are educational illustrations. They are not an instruction or recommendation to enter a transaction or select a broker or financial instrument.

1.6. These Terms are published in English. Unless mandatory law provides otherwise, the English text governs the interpretation of any translation. Product language is stated in the relevant description.
2.1. “Account” means your registered customer profile and access to the Service.

2.2. “Usage Units” means prepaid, non-transferable credits that can be redeemed for eligible educational products and features within Cur Nova. “Usage Balance” or “Wallet” means the record of those credits in your Account. Usage Units are not offered as an investment, a bank deposit or a means of payment outside the Service. Refund rights are addressed in section 9 and the Refund and Return Policy.
2.3. “Ready-Made Courses” means existing PDF courses offered for digital access or download after purchase or redemption.
2.4. “Trader Custom Courses” means individual educational PDF courses prepared by human traders or mentors using the information and requirements supplied for the order.

2.5. “AI Custom Courses” means educational courses created using AI from your prompts and selected generation fields. Human preparation or review is included only if the product description expressly says so.

2.6. “AI Strategy Outputs” means educational strategy documents and any associated diagrams or supporting assets generated through the AI Strategy Builder. They are not trading signals or personalised investment recommendations.

2.7. “Custom Courses” collectively refers to Trader Custom Courses and AI Custom Courses. “Content” includes Ready-Made Courses, Custom Courses, AI Strategy Outputs and other educational materials supplied through the Service.
2.8. “Client Data” means information you submit, including prompts, intake responses, educational goals, experience, preferences, notes and files.
2.9. “Order” means a purchase of Usage Units or Content, or a confirmed redemption of Usage Units for a specific product or paid feature. A top-up and a later redemption are distinct transactions.
2.10. “Library” or “Dashboard” means the customer area used to access available purchases, balances, order information and account settings.

2.11. “Consumer” means an individual acting wholly or mainly outside their trade, business, craft or profession, as determined by applicable law. Buying through an Account does not, by itself, determine whether you are a Consumer.
3.1. You must be at least 18 years old to use the Service. If you act for an organisation, you must also have authority to enter into the relevant agreement on its behalf.
3.2. Provide accurate registration and billing information and update it when necessary. We may take reasonable steps to verify account ownership or investigate suspected unauthorised use.
3.3. Keep your login details secure. Tell us promptly at info@cur-nova.com if you believe your Account or payment details have been used without authorisation.

3.4. You are responsible for activity you authorise through your Account. This does not make you automatically responsible for unauthorised activity or remove any protection available under applicable law.
3.5. Account restrictions and termination are governed by section 17. Exercising a legitimate cancellation, refund or payment-dispute right is not, by itself, a breach of these Terms.

sections.title: Nature of the Service and orders

content.text: 4.1. The Service may offer Ready-Made Courses, Trader Custom Courses, AI Custom Courses, AI Strategy Outputs, templates, educational resources, calculators and related dashboard features. Availability and the features included in a particular purchase are described before the order is placed.

4.4. We confirm purchases or redemptions electronically. Where applicable, confirmation includes your request or consent for early performance and your acknowledgement of its effect on cancellation rights, in a form you can retain.

5.3. AI materials can contain inaccuracies and require critical review. Educational content may also become outdated as markets change. These limitations do not excuse failure to meet the agreed description or applicable statutory quality standards.

This is the normal processing period rather than a guarantee that every request will finish within a fixed number of minutes.

5.11. No physical shipping is involved. You need suitable software and a compatible device to access the formats disclosed before purchase. Contact us if a file is missing, corrupted or inaccessible so we can investigate and provide the applicable remedy.
